_om: Minesveiperen in English (Minefield, rusj.no/en/minefield/): minesweeper, with «Today's minefield». Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Trykk på brettet for å zoome inn: Tap the board to zoom in
Dra for å se resten · trykk for flagg: Drag to see the rest · tap to flag
Dra for å se resten · hold inne for flag: Drag to see the rest · hold to flag
Trykk for å åpne · hold inne for flagg: Tap to open · hold to flag
Kaboom! There was a mine there.
Piltaster flytter · Enter åpner · F sett: Arrow keys move · Enter opens · F flags · + and − zoom
Under rutene ligger det miner. Åpne alle: There are mines hidden under the squares. Open all the safe squares – without tapping a mine.
Første trykk er alltid trygt. Et tall fo: Your first tap is always safe. A number tells you how many mines touch that square – diagonals included.
Hold fingeren på en rute (eller slå på F: Hold your finger on a square (or switch on Flag) to mark a mine you've found.
Når alle trygge ruter er åpne, har du vu: When every safe square is open, you've won. Can you do it faster next time?
Står det 1 ved siden av bare én lukket r: If a 1 touches only one closed square, the mine is there.
Trykk på et tall når alle flaggene rundt: Tap a number once all the flags around it are placed, and the rest around it open in one go.
Middels og ekspert er store: Dra for å f: Medium and expert are big: drag to move around, and use − and + to zoom.
Trykk på fjeset øverst for å starte et n: Tap the face at the top to start a new board.
Med «Uten gjetting» kan hvert brett rydd: With ‘No guessing’, every board can be cleared by logic alone. If it goes bang, there was a safe move.
Dagens minefelt er det samme for alle i: Today's minefield is the same for everyone. It grows through the week: 9 × 9 from Monday, 12 × 12 on Friday and Saturday, 16 × 16 on Sunday.
Med tastatur: Tab til brettet, piltaster: On a keyboard: Tab to the board, arrow keys move, Enter opens, F places a flag, + and − zoom.
The board can always be cleared with logic.
Your first tap is always safe.
Dagens minefelt kan ryddes helt uten å g: Today's minefield can be cleared without any guessing. The same board is waiting – have another go!
Ny personlig rekord på {niva}! Forrige:: A new personal best on {niva}! Previous: {tid}.
Første seier på {niva} – nå har du en re: Your first win on {niva} – now you've got a time to beat!
Dette brettet kunne ryddes uten å gjette: This board could be cleared without guessing. Next time, look for the number that gives the mine away!
Det var nære på! Én mine skilte deg fra: So close! One mine stood between you and victory.
Minene gjemmer seg godt. Neste brett kan: The mines hide well. The next board could be yours!
Det samme brettet, fra start. Det blir {: The same board, from the start. This will be try {n}.
The board you're playing will be lost.
